3240-6277-6462-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2226-2543-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2543-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Shivan Wurm by paying its mana cost.
When Shivan Wurm enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

512-2085-3443.easyPrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
512-2085-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
512-2085-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Deathbloom Ritualist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-2085-3443.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Deathbloom Ritualist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

529-3197-4742-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2033-2713-4687.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2033-2713-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

3562-3817-4247-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sky Hussar, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

240-4742-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-4742-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

864-7694-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
864-7694-8043.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5448-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5448-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Druid Class
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1753-2411-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-2411-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1619-2034-4605-5542-6148.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6148.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Seasoned Dungeoneer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Seasoned Dungeoneer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Seasoned Dungeoneer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6148.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

670-1619-6146-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6146-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Ravenloft Adventurer until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Ravenloft Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Ravenloft Adventurer until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

3197-5789-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-5789-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

5759-6338-7711.manaNeeded: {2}{W} if you don't control your commander
5759-6338-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
5759-6338-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Screaming Nemesis indestructible using Flawless Maneuver.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
5759-6338-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

5016-6779-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
5016-6779-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Spitemare indestructible using Selfless Spirit.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
5016-6779-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

647-1368-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
647-1368-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1367-1409-7417.description:
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Activate Sanar by paying {1}{U}, blinking Sanar. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
When Sanar enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing Sanar and Deadeye Navigator.
Repeat each turn.
1367-1409-7417.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

2099-3764-7363.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the Mutagen.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

57-2341-4846-7297.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon isn't your commander.
57-2341-4846-7297.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1486-1753-5475-7223.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
1486-1753-5475-7223.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1479-3478-7201.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3478-7201.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Sapling Nursery, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2034-4094-5320.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
2034-4094-5320.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Use Ashnod's Altar to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 4.
2034-4094-5320.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Ashnod's Altar, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

4375-5231-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

589-2275-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-2275-4017.description:
Gain life.
Fathom Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

913-1358-2073-4659--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the mana value 1 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sydri's first ability by paying {U}, causing the artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

813-2955-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Justiciar's Portal.
813-2955-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

396-2060-4013-4929-6457.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Felothar.
When Felothar enters the battlefield, it and Blessed Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a token.
Resolve the Felothar trigger, causing you to sacrifice a nonland permanent and put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
396-2060-4013-4929-6457.notes: The combo does not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Felothar, Crystalline Crawler or Cryptic Trilobite.

1274-3490-4050-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1274-3490-4050-6458.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4050-6458.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2583-3921-5870-5874.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Sphinx of the Revelation triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

225-1669-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
225-1669-5720-5721.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for the remaining triggers.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

4871-5111-5189.notablePrerequisites: Ghave has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or there is a +1/+1 counter on another creature you control.
4871-5111-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1437-3750-5184-5401.notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least one indestructible counter on it.
Bilbo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1437-3750-5184-5401.description:
Cast Xorn by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Xorn spell three times.
Resolve all Xorn spells.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Bilbo.
Bilbo's second ability triggers, creating five Treasure tokens due to the four Xorns.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 4.

1329-3263-3693-4853.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-3263-3693-4853.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Walking Ballista from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4068-4689.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-4689.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

851-1651-4231-4732-5261.notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
851-1651-4231-4732-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two untapped artifacts you control to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

147-1532-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1532-5256.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

224-433-3147.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.
